scripts.docker:macvlan: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -f macvlan.yml up -d
scripts.docker:macvlan:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -f macvlan.yml down
scripts.docker:macvlan:restart: bun run docker:macvlan:down && bun run docker:macvlan
scripts.docker:dev:restart: bun run docker:dev:down && bun run docker:dev
